battle.name: 後晉滅後唐之戰
battle.brief: 936年正月，成德節度使安重榮在趙州起兵，河東節度使石敬瑭退守太原。掌書記桑維翰力主借契丹之兵，割燕雲十六州換取援軍，遼太宗耶律德光南下破洛陽，末帝李從厚出亡，後唐亡而後晉代立。守城一方以秦弩布於城頭，萬弩齊發壓制鐵騎衝鋒，弩陣是潞州、洛陽兩城撐到最後的關鍵。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的一方是中原的後唐：自李存勗開基、末帝李從厚在位的沙陀王朝，名義上以洛陽為都，握有禁軍，又以成德、魏博、河東、昭義等方鎮的節度使為骨架。各道節度使掌本道兵馬、財賦與生殺，朝廷對藩鎮的號令往往止於一紙詔書。另一方並非單一政權，而是三方糾結的聯軍：起兵的是成德節度使安重榮，響應的是樞密使趙思河所領的北面將領，決定戰局的第三方則是契丹（遼），由契丹主耶律德光親率大軍南下。太原的河東軍由石敬瑭、桑維翰、劉知遠、杜重威等人掌握，日後取代後唐的後晉正是這支軍系。戰場橫跨今山西、河北、河南三地，主要城市為太原、潞州、洛陽、趙州與鄴都，多數交鋒發生在城池與城下的短距離之中，決定勝負的卻是誰能控制糧道與援軍。
countriesEn: One side was Later Tang, the Central Plain state founded by the Shatuo warlord Li Cunxu and now ruled by the last emperor Li Conghou, nominally based at Luoyang, holding the imperial guards, and built on the backbone of the regional military governors of Chengde, Weibo, Hedong, Zhaoyi and other circuits. Each circuit governor commanded the troops, revenue and capital punishment of his own circuit, and imperial orders often ended at the edge of the writ. The other side was not a single state at all but a three-way knot: Chengde governor An Chongrong raised the revolt, the northern commanders under Privy Council director Zhao Sihhe answered it, and the third party that decided the war was the Khitan (Liao), whose ruler Yelü Deguang led the invading army in person. The Hedong army at Taiyuan was held by Shi Jingtang, Sang Weihan, Liu Zhiyuan and Du Zhongwei, and it was precisely this military faction that would replace Later Tang with Later Jin. The fighting stretched across what is now Shanxi, Hebei and Henan, with Taiyuan, Luzhou, Luoyang, Zhaozhou and Yedu as the main towns; most engagements were fought in close quarters at the walls and in the open ground below them, yet what settled the outcome was control of supply lines and reinforcements.
people: 石敬瑭是這場戰爭的另一個主角。他出身後唐宗室與大將，自鎮太原多年，帳下有精兵與能吏，後唐朝廷對他又倚重又防範。李從厚末年削弱藩鎮、猜忌河東，石敬瑭自知不能見容，於是與心腹密議。河東節度掌書記桑維翰力主借契丹之兵以絕後患，河東大將劉知遠則主張乘勢稱帝，兩人分別成為後晉建國的文與武兩面。另一名大將杜重威主張死守河東、反對割地，是主戰派的中樞。後唐一方，末帝李從厚是失敗的決策者；樞密使趙思河奉命統率北面行營北伐，卻在半途被自己部將所殺，北面軍心隨之崩潰，援軍反而成了潰兵；成德節度使安重榮起兵反抗朝廷，首鼠兩端終被擒殺。契丹主耶律德光是全過程中唯一握有主動權的外部人物，他選擇扶植石敬瑭而非直接顛覆中原，這一選擇改變了此後百年的北亞格局。
peopleEn: Shi Jingtang is the other central figure of this war. A descendant of the Later Tang ruling clan and a seasoned commander, he had held Taiyuan for many years with picked troops and competent staff around him, and the Later Tang court both relied on him and feared him. In the last years of Li Conghou, as the court trimmed the power of the regional governors and grew suspicious of Hedong, Shi understood that he could not expect to survive, and he began conferring in secret with his closest associates. Sang Weihan, the military secretary of Hedong, argued forcefully for borrowing Khitan troops to remove the threat once and for all, while the Hedong general Liu Zhiyuan pressed for proclaiming the empire as soon as the moment allowed; between them they became the civil and the martial faces of the new Later Jin. Another general, Du Zhongwei, held that Hedong should simply hold out and refused any cession of territory, and he was the hinge of the hawkish party. On the Later Tang side, the last emperor Li Conghou was the man whose decisions lost the war. Privy Council director Zhao Sihhe was ordered to lead the northern army north, but was killed by his own officers partway there; the morale of the northern host broke with him, so the relief force turned into a rout. Chengde governor An Chongrong, who had started the rising against the court, tried every side and was finally captured and executed. Yelü Deguang, the Khitan ruler, was the only external actor who held the initiative throughout; he chose to sponsor Shi Jingtang rather than overturn the Central Plain directly, and that single choice reshaped the political geography of northern Asia for the century that followed.
kits: 卡面上的兵器是秦弩，也就是中國式的弩機。弩的關鍵在於把拉弓的力先存進弩機，再由扳機一次釋放，單兵可以反覆射擊而不必每發都拉弦；自戰國以來到唐五代，弩始終是守城與野戰的骨幹。936年的戰局中，秦弩主要出現在三個位置：太原城頭的守軍以成排弩手輪番齊射，壓制契丹騎兵的逼近；洛陽與潞州兩處城防在守軍離心、外援斷絕的最後階段，靠弩陣與拒馬、鹿角共同撐住城門；守軍反擊與追擊時，也以弩矢封鎖城下的開闊地，迫使騎兵無法展開衝鋒。與之配合的裝備包括唐末常見的步人甲與明光甲、橫刀與長柄戟、角弓與拋射石器，契丹軍則以複合弓、長矛與馬刀為主，鐵騎衝陣之後即下馬步戰。攻城一方除輕騎急襲外，還備有巢車、撞竿，以及唐末文獻已記載的發火機一類火器。糧秣方面，太原依靠倉儲與河運，騎兵則以乾餅、乾肉隨身攜帶。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Chinese crossbow, the repeating bow mechanism of the Chinese type. Its whole point is that the strain of drawing the bow is stored in the lock and then released in one pull of the trigger, so a single man can shoot again and again without having to re-draw the string each time; from the Warring States period through the Tang and the Five Dynasties, the crossbow remained the backbone of siege defence and of field combat alike. In the campaign of 936 the crossbow occupied three main positions. On the walls of Taiyuan the garrison stood in ranks of crossbowmen firing in relays, pressing the Khitan horse back as it closed. At Luoyang and at Luzhou, where the garrisons had lost heart and their relief had been cut off, it was the crossbow line together with caltrops and antler barriers that kept the gates from giving way. In counter-attacks and pursuits the defenders also used crossbow bolts to seal the open ground below the walls, denying the cavalry the room it needed to form a charge. Working alongside it were the armours and weapons usual in late Tang: lamellar and mingguang plate for the infantry, cross-sabres and long-hafted tridents, composite bows and thrown missiles. The Khitan fought with composite bows, long spears and single-edged sabres, dismounting to fight on foot once their charge had been made. On the attacking side, besides fast mounted raids, the column carried siege towers, battering rams and, in the fire-weapons line recorded in late Tang sources, the so-called fire-throwing engine. On the logistics side Taiyuan drew on its granaries and river transport, while the cavalry carried hard biscuits and dried meat on their own saddles.
tactics: 整場戰爭的戰術主軸，可以用守城、斷糧、外援、反擊四步概括。起兵之初，石敬瑭放棄在河東腹地與叛軍周旋，退守太原憑城固守，以秦弩布於城頭，覆射城下進逼之敵，靠城堞與街壘把騎兵的衝鋒拆散，同時遣精騎繞出城北，切斷趙州方向通往太原的糧道與驛路。趙思河率領的後唐北面軍本應是解太原之圍的力量，卻在行軍途中因內部譁變而自行瓦解，救援變成了潰散，攻守之勢於是傾斜。契丹大軍南下的時候不與河東軍正面纏鬥，而是以一部沿河北平原疾進，直趨洛陽，斷絕中原的指揮中樞；另一部與河東軍會合，攻取昭義軍治潞州，把太原與洛陽之間的聯繫一段段切斷。洛陽既下，契丹鐵騎在河北平原上再也沒有能正面阻擋的成建制兵團，遂得以長驅直入。河東軍最後的動作不是死守洛陽，而是乘勢追擊潰兵、分略河北諸州，並以接管洛陽、接收中原的倉儲與官僚網來鞏固新朝。
tacticsEn: The tactical spine of the whole campaign can be reduced to four steps: hold the city, cut the supply, bring in the relief, counter-attack. At the opening Shi Jingtang gave up manoeuvring against the rebels in the open country of Hedong and withdrew to Taiyuan, where he fought from the strength of the walls. Crossbows were posted along the ramparts in overlapping volleys, the front of the enemy below the city was swept by bolt after bolt, and the barricaded streets and palisades broke the cavalry charge into fragments. At the same time he sent picked riders out around the north of the city to cut the grain road and the courier stations leading to Taiyuan from the Zhaozhou direction. The Later Tang northern army under Zhao Sihhe should have been the relief that lifted the siege, but it dissolved through an internal mutiny on the march; the relief became a rout and the balance of attack and defence tipped accordingly. When the Khitan host moved south it did not engage the Hedong army in open battle. One part swept along the Hebei plain toward Luoyang, cutting off the command centre of the Central Plain, while another joined with the Hedong forces to take Luzhou, the seat of Zhaoyi, and broke the line of contact between Taiyuan and Luoyang piece by piece. Once Luoyang had fallen, the Khitan cavalry met no formed body on the Hebei plain capable of blocking them, and they drove on unchecked. The last move of the Hedong army was not to hold Luoyang to the end but to pursue the fugitives, to take possession of the Hebei circuits, and to consolidate the new dynasty by taking over Luoyang, its granaries and its administrative apparatus.
data: 關於兵員與物資，史料留下的數字多有出入，此處只列較為可靠的時間與數目。時間線最為清楚：936年正月，成德節度使安重榮在趙州起兵；同年秋，後唐朝廷罷石敬瑭河東節度使之職、召之入洛陽，河東軍拒詔，雙方矛盾表面化（詔令的具體內容各傳說法略有出入）；十月至十一月間，石敬瑭遣使馳詣契丹（使者姓名各傳所載不一，或云劉福），十一月契丹主耶律德光率軍南下；十二月，後唐京城洛陽失守，李從厚出奔，次年石敬瑭在太原即位，改元天福。疆域上，割讓的燕雲十六州包括幽州、雲州等州縣，數目是十六，涵蓋今河北北部與山西北部一線。國祚方面，後唐自923年李存勗建國到936年滅亡，前後不過十三年；後晉自936年立國到947年契丹攻陷汴州而亡，十一年。兵力規模方面，可確知的是契丹南下的軍隊以數萬計，並有漢人州縣提供的糧賦與步卒配合；河東軍精銳但人數有限，後唐禁軍與各道勤王兵亦以萬計。三個月的戰事中沒有任何一方能全殲對手，決定勝負的是政治崩潰而不是戰術上的殲滅。
dataEn: On troop numbers and supplies the historical record disagrees often, so only the more reliable dates and figures are set down here. The chronology is the clearest part: in the first month of 936 Chengde governor An Chongrong rose in revolt at Zhaozhou; in the autumn of the same year the Later Tang court stripped Shi Jingtang of the governorship of Hedong and summoned him to Luoyang, the Hedong army refused the order, and the rupture between the two sides became public, though the precise wording of the edict varies from source to source; between the tenth and eleventh months Shi Jingtang dispatched envoys to the Khitan, the name of the envoy being recorded variously, one version giving Liu Fu; in the eleventh month Yelü Deguang led the Khitan army south; in the twelfth month the Later Tang capital of Luoyang was lost and Li Conghou fled, and in the following year Shi Jingtang took the throne at Taiyuan and opened the Tianfu era. On territory, the sixteen prefectures of Yan and Yun that were ceded, including Youzhou, Yunzhou and the rest, number sixteen and cover a line along today's northern Hebei and northern Shanxi. As for the life of the states, Later Tang lasted from the founding of Li Cunxu in 923 to its fall in 936, thirteen years in all, while Later Jin lasted eleven years, from its founding in 936 to its destruction when the Khitan took Bianzhou in 947. On the scale of forces, what can be established is that the Khitan invading host numbered in the tens of thousands and drew on grain, revenue and infantry from Han-administered prefectures, that the Hedong army was picked but not numerous, and that the Later Tang guards and the relief armies drawn from the various circuits were likewise counted in the tens of thousands. In three months of war neither side ever annihilated the other; what decided the outcome was political collapse, not tactical destruction.
cause: 要理解936年的結局，先要看後唐末年的結構性問題。後唐是沙陀人建立的短命王朝，承襲了唐末藩鎮割據的格局：中央靠禁軍維持局面，方鎮掌握兵源與財賦，李存勗與李嗣源兩代尚能壓住諸將，到了李從厚手上，局勢迅速惡化。末帝在位期間斂財急迫，加派雜稅以充內廷，一次次加碼的額外徵斂最終落到方鎮與州縣頭上，成德、魏博一帶的節度使早已不把朝廷詔令放在眼裡。安重榮自恃河朔舊慣，屢拒詔命，936年正月在趙州舉兵，把藩鎮與中央之間的衝突擺到了明面上。石敬瑭這邊則是另一層矛盾：他以河東軍為根基，資望與實力都在那裡，末帝既依賴他守住北門，又懼怕他擁兵自重，削職、召還一類的處置在所難免。於是兩個不甘坐困的軍閥在一個失控的朝廷裡正面相撞，而外部的契丹，只是把已經裂開的縫撕得更大。
causeEn: To understand how 936 ended, one has to look first at the structural problems of late Later Tang. Later Tang was a short-lived dynasty founded by Shatuo Turks and inherited the fragmented pattern of late Tang fanzhen: the centre held the situation together with the imperial guards while the regional governors kept the manpower and the revenue; the reigns of Li Cunxu and Li Siyuan were able to hold the various commanders down, but under Li Conghou the situation deteriorated fast. The last emperor's reign was marked by frantic extraction, with surtaxes imposed to fill the inner court, and the repeated additional levies eventually fell on the circuits and prefectures, so that governors in Chengde and Weibo had long since stopped treating imperial orders as binding. An Chongrong, emboldened by the old habits of the Hebei region, refused orders again and again and rose at Zhaozhou in the first month of 936, dragging the conflict between the circuit governors and the centre out into the open. On Shi Jingtang's side lay a different contradiction: his base was the Hedong army and both his standing and his strength were there, so the last emperor both depended on him to hold the northern gate and feared that he might use his troops to make a bid for power; measures such as stripping his command or summoning him to the capital were unavoidable. Two military strongmen who would not sit still therefore collided inside a government that had already lost control, and the external Khitan simply tore an already open seam wider.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響遠遠超過它本身三個月的作戰時間。第一，燕雲十六州落入契丹（遼）之手，中原第一次失去北面屏障，遼的鐵騎自此可以直抵黃河北岸與太行山麓；後晉雖是一時雄主，卻在十一年後即被同一支契丹軍隊攻陷汴州而覆亡。936年的割地等於用一次王朝更替的代價，換來了一道再也沒有合上的缺口，後來宋太祖收復燕雲的種種努力幾乎都止步於此。第二，五代中原政權第一次公開以稱臣甚至父事契丹的方式換取軍事援助，為後來各代的外交取向樹立了惡劣榜樣，也讓北方遊牧政權看到介入中原的可行路徑。第三，後唐的官僚與軍將大批被後晉吸收，五代十國在形式上收束為北方一統加南面的並立局面：南唐、吳越、荊南、南漢、後蜀各霸一方，而中原王朝第一次可以把主要精力用來對付南面，北面的邊防卻要花去數百年的時間慢慢重新築回來。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reach far beyond the three months of fighting it actually lasted. First, the sixteen prefectures of Yan and Yun passed to the Khitan, and the Central Plain lost its northern barrier for the first time; from then on Khitan cavalry could ride to the north bank of the Yellow River and into the foothills of the Taihang. Later Jin, momentary master of the realm, was itself destroyed eleven years later when the same Khitan host took Bianzhou. The cession of 936 therefore paid for one dynastic turnover with a gap that was never closed again, and every later effort by the Song to recover Yan and Yun ran into that same wall. Second, a Central Plain regime of the Five Dynasties for the first time openly bought military aid by acknowledging vassalage to the Khitan, even by treating their ruler as a father, and this set a bad precedent for the diplomatic conduct of later dynasties while showing the northern steppe powers that intervention in the Central Plain was feasible. Third, the officials and commanders of Later Tang were absorbed wholesale by Later Jin, and the ten kingdoms of the Five Dynasties formally contracted into a northern union alongside the southern states of Southern Tang, Wuyue, Jingnan, Southern Han and Later Shu. The Central Plain dynasty could for the first time direct most of its effort southward, while its northern frontier would take several more centuries to rebuild itself.
result: 936年十一月，契丹大軍抵達洛陽，後唐京城淪陷，末帝李從厚出奔，輾轉至華州被軍人擒獲，解送洛陽後被處死，後唐祚運至此為止。十二月，石敬瑭在太原即位，建立後晉，改元天福，以洛陽為都，三年後遷都汴州。割讓燕雲十六州與稱臣於契丹主耶律德光這兩條協議，等於把後唐數百年的北疆成果一次交出，也把這場起於方鎮叛亂、終於外族干預的戰爭，寫成了五代史上最屈辱的一頁。對參戰各方而言，結果並非全然均等：安重榮兵敗被擒殺，趙思河被自己人殺死，北面軍隨之瓦解；契丹得到燕雲與中原的臣服，實力卻消耗在長途遠征與內部的權力交接上；河東軍系完成了從節度使部曲到王朝禁軍的轉身；被滅的後唐留下的土地、倉儲與官僚網，幾乎原封不動地被石敬瑭接手。幾乎所有人都預料得到後唐會崩潰，卻沒有人預料到崩潰會以這樣的方式完成。
resultEn: In the eleventh month of 936 the Khitan host reached Luoyang, the Later Tang capital fell, the last emperor Li Conghou fled, was taken by soldiers at Huazhou after wandering east from Taiyuan, and was put to death after being sent back to Luoyang; with that the Later Tang was finished. In the twelfth month Shi Jingtang took the throne at Taiyuan, founded the Later Jin, opened the Tianfu era, made Luoyang the capital and moved the seat of government to Bianzhou three years later. The two clauses of the settlement, the cession of the sixteen prefectures of Yan and Yun and the acknowledgement of vassalage to Yelü Deguang, handed over in a single stroke what the Later Tang had built on its northern frontier over several centuries, and they fixed this war, begun in a revolt of the circuit governors and ended in foreign intervention, as the most humiliating page in Five Dynasties history. The outcome was not equal across the participants. An Chongrong was defeated, captured and killed; Zhao Sihhe was killed by his own men and the northern army dissolved with him. The Khitan gained Yan, Yun and the submission of the Central Plain, but spent the strength that had carried it so far on a long march and on a contested succession at home. The Hedong military faction completed its transformation from a governor's private army into the guards of a dynasty, and the lands, granaries and administrative networks of the destroyed Later Tang were taken over by Shi Jingtang almost intact. Everyone expected the Later Tang to fall; almost no one expected it to fall in this particular way.
